exposure: Manual reduction of abnormal uterine inclination
outcome: Duration of first stage of labor
Duration of second stage of labor
Duration of third stage of labor
cohort: The study included 40 primiparas with abnormal uterine inclination who were randomly divided into treatment and control groups.
finding: Manual reduction of abnormal uterine inclination significantly shortened the first and second stages of labor and increased the rate of uterine inclination correction, without significantly affecting the third stage of labor, postpartum hemorrhage, or fetal outcomes.
